about.title: Web Developer And Telegram bot Developer
about.body:
I’m Dagim Desalegn, a Junior Full-Stack Developer from Ethiopia. I enjoy building useful digital products that are clear, reliable, and actually solve real problems.

I graduated in Computer Science from Jimma University and have worked on projects like Erdataye, an emergency service app for rapid ambulance dispatch and live tracking, and ABJ Tutorial, an educational platform that has helped thousands of students. I’ve also completed certifications in web development, programming fundamentals, and AI.

I care about thoughtful interfaces, clean code, and building things that make life a little easier for people.

experience.company: Yosti Import and Export Trading Co.
experience.description: As a Software Developer, the Employee is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications; developing and maintaining backend systems, databases, and APIs; maintaining Company websites and digital platforms; troubleshooting and resolving technical issues; ensuring system security, performance, and reliability; and performing other related duties as assigned by the Company.

certificates.description: I have acquired the skills necessary to build responsive websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Furthermore, this course provided me with a foundational understanding of web development.
